heroTitle: Infrastructure that scales with the screen, not the calendar.
heroDescription: Discovery and engineering workloads are bursty a billion compound screen one month, a batch of strain design simulations the next. We build cloud infrastructure that matches that pattern instead of fighting it.
capabilities: Auto-scaling compute pools tuned for screening, simulation, and ML workloads
Storage lifecycle policies across raw, intermediate, and archival tiers
Cost visibility broken down by project, program, or grant
Runs inside your own cloud account your data stays under your control
relatedText: Cloud infrastructure is typically set up as part of a Pipeline Development engagement.
